feedback: If a child predicts 'the same because I pushed the same', point to the carpet stopping the ball sooner and name the rough surface rubbing as the cause.
If a child explains continued rolling by a push 'stored inside', gently point to the floor/carpet rubbing as what slows it; expect this idea to come back and revisit it on slippery vs rough floors.
When a cushion slows the already-rolling ball, name it: 'The cushion pushed back against the ball and slowed it — that push changed its motion.'
activities.intendedInsight: Things slow and stop because a surface (or air) rubs against them and pushes back — friction — not because the push is used up inside the object.
learnerActions: Give one ball the same push on a smooth floor and then on a rough carpet.
Before each roll, predict which will travel further and say why.
Watch the carpet ball stop sooner and talk about what was different between the two surfaces.
Try to slow a ball that is already rolling toward you without catching it (for example, hold a cushion in its path).
activities.title: Compare smooth vs rough: why things stop

feedback: Confirm correct sorts and, for mistakes, mime the action together to decide whether you are pushing away or pulling toward.
When predicting direction for an object at rest, link it back: 'If the push is strong enough and nothing holds it in place, it starts to move the way the push points.'
activities.intendedInsight: Pushes and pulls happen all around us; naming them and reading the direction of the force builds the vocabulary that supports the hands-on experiences.
learnerActions: Sort picture cards of everyday actions into PUSH and PULL (with an adult reading or audio support).
Look at a playground or home scene and point out where someone is pushing and where someone is pulling (for example, pulling a child on a swing, pushing a trolley).
For a pictured object at rest about to be pushed, point which way it will start to move.
Use the words push, pull, and force as you describe what is happening.
activities.title: Name pushes and pulls around us
